authoritative_for: Semantics owns project registration and routing, stable concept identity, append-only semantic revisions and typed effects, intake policy and cursors, reconciliation validation, and semantic commit success.
not_authoritative_for: Participating products own runtime behavior; Decisions owns lifecycle facts, Conversations owns task metadata, and Nucleus owns bounded execution rather than semantic truth.

covers: All supported public Semantics CLI outcomes for repository exploration, project and intake operation, installation, recovery, and product development in this release.
excludes: Help and version display, direct SQLite access, upstream product capabilities, implementation helpers, and current service readiness are outside this inventory claim.

shared_access_and_trust: Repository reads and administrative writes use local-user interfaces; the worker receives only published upstream data and never grants Nucleus project workspace, shell, or web access.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Semantics retains private normalized meanings and provenance but no raw transcript, diff, command, prompt, credential, or project-file body.
compatibility_and_retirement: Provider release identifies these exact bundle bytes; entry contracts, SQLite schema, immutable toolsets, and semantic revision numbers remain separate version axes.
operational_limits: Semantics is a local project registry with one serial bounded worker; per-entry contracts define replay, project, page, and reconciliation bounds.
